title: to in at (places 3)
summary: Когда после глаголов движения и места ставить **to**, **in** или **at**: go to the cinema, arrive in London, arrive at the station, go home.
ru:
## to — куда мы двигаемся
С глаголами движения (go, come, walk, drive, return) используем **to**.
> We went **to** the park. — Мы пошли в парк.
> She's driving **to** Bishkek. — Она едет в Бишкек.
> When are you coming **to** our house? — Когда ты придёшь к нам?

## in / at — где мы находимся
Если мы уже на месте, говорим **in** или **at**.
> We were **in** the park. — Мы были в парке.
> They're **at** the cinema. — Они в кинотеатре.

## been to
**Have been to** = «бывал / ходил и вернулся».
> I've **been to** Turkey. — Я была в Турции.
> Have you ever **been to** a concert? — Ты когда-нибудь был на концерте?

## get / arrive
- **get to** + место: *We got **to** the hotel at ten.*
- **arrive in** + город или страна: *They arrived **in** Almaty.*
- **arrive at** + более маленькое место (станция, аэропорт, дом, офис): *We arrived **at** the station.*

## home — без предлога
Слово **home** не требует to: ~~go to home~~ → **go home**, **come home**, **get home**. Но: **at home** (где?).
> I got home late. — Я поздно пришла домой.
> I'm at home. — Я дома.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~We went in the cinema.~~ → We went **to** the cinema.
- ~~I go to home.~~ → I go **home**.
- ~~We arrived to Moscow.~~ → We arrived **in** Moscow.
- ~~She arrived to the airport.~~ → She arrived **at** the airport.
en:
## to — movement
After verbs of movement (go, come, walk, drive, return) we use **to**.
> We went **to** the park.
> She's driving **to** Bishkek.
> When are you coming **to** our house?

## in / at — position
When we are already there, we use **in** or **at**.
> We were **in** the park.
> They're **at** the cinema.

## been to
**Have been to** means you went there and came back.
> I've **been to** Turkey.
> Have you ever **been to** a concert?

## get / arrive
- **get to** + place: *We got **to** the hotel at ten.*
- **arrive in** + a city or country: *They arrived **in** Almaty.*
- **arrive at** + a smaller place (station, airport, house, office): *We arrived **at** the station.*

## home — no preposition
We don't use **to** with **home**: **go home**, **come home**, **get home**. But we say **at home** for position.

## Common mistakes
- ~~We went in the cinema.~~ → We went **to** the cinema.
- ~~I go to home.~~ → I go **home**.
- ~~We arrived to Moscow.~~ → We arrived **in** Moscow.
structure:
## Схема
| Ситуация | Предлог | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| движение | **to** | go to school, walk to the shop |
| нахождение (внутри, в городе) | **in** | in London, in the park |
| нахождение (точка, событие) | **at** | at the station, at a party |
| прибытие в город / страну | **arrive in** | arrive in Paris |
| прибытие в место поменьше | **arrive at** | arrive at the airport |
| дом | без предлога | go home, get home, come home |

## Формулы
> go / come / walk / drive **to** + место
> get **to** + место
> be **in / at** + место
> Have + been **to** + место

## Запомните
- **home**: *go home*, но *be at home*.
- **there / here**: *go there*, *come here* — тоже без to.

items.text: We went {{to}} the beach yesterday.
Is Sara {{at}} the bank?

My parents live {{in}} a small village.
Let's go {{to}} the cinema tonight.
Were you {{at}} the party on Friday?
They're coming {{to}} our wedding.
I stayed {{in}} Paris for a week.

exercises.title: Arrive, get, go
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **to**, **in**, **at** или поставьте **—**, если предлог не нужен.

items.text: We arrived {{in}} Tokyo on Monday morning.
What time do you get {{to}} work?
I was tired, so I went {{—|-}} home early.
They arrived {{at}} the hotel at midnight.
When did she get {{—|-}} home last night?
The plane arrived {{at}} the airport on time.
